meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
The three-fourths (3/4) pay for the year following the sabbatical leave shall not be construed as a voluntary demotion under the Teacher Tenure Act, MN Statute §122A.41.
In accordance with Minnesota Statutes §124E.12, Subd. 6, written requests for charter school leaves received by February 1 shall be approved in accordance with this statute.
No teacher shall be discharged or in any way discriminated against because such teacher has filed a complaint or followed any procedures pursuant to the Minnesota Right-to-Know statute or Section 12.1.7 of this article.
Workloads for specific special education programs are delineated in MN Rule 3525-2325.
